sample_unit: bariatric patients rating responses (200 questions answered)
unlisted_practices: Comparing patient-rated clarity, completeness and empathy of LLM-drafted versus physician-written responses to bariatric patient questions
Measuring physician correction time for LLM responses

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates GPT-4o versus physician responses to real-world bariatric patient questions, with evaluation by an expert physician and rating by patients. It assesses performance and human correction time but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice comparative intervention.
